text_block_list.text:
Though people had treated their showdown 
as a mere spectacle, the sheer intensity 
of the race caught everyone off guard, 
leaving much of the audience utterly 
stunned.

Hishi Akebono was overjoyed to have been 
able to give the race her all. She was 
also able to confirm her body was in peak 
condition.

Promising to eventually run in the "Mile 
Championship", she decides on her next 
target race: the "Swan Stakes"!

Meanwhile... Biko Pegasus was sulking all 
by herself, while Taiki Shuttle was in the 
stands, utterly thrilled by the race.

Amid a swirl of mixed emotions, the race 
came to a close... and the days leading up 
to the next Swan Stakes began.
